messages:
VendorOpsBot: heads-up: CloudBridge posted an incident about a possible token exposure during a deploy. https://status.cloudbridge.example/incidents/452
Maya R.: who here owns the CloudBridge sync? any idea what secrets they use?
Sam K.: integrations team. they use a service token stored in Vault under secret/integrations/cloudbridge. @Security Oncall can you confirm rotation date and scope?
Security Oncall: checking Vault audit. secret/integrations/cloudbridge/sync-token last rotated 2024-08-12. pulling access logs now.
Lee T.: vendor says a debug dump may have contained the token and that an S3 ACL was briefly set to public-read. we need to know if our principal made any requests to their bucket. run CloudTrail/ATHENA query for GetObject/HeadObject with that bucket name in the last 48h.
Security Oncall: initiating quick Athena query. sample:
```
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, sourceIPAddress
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE requestParameters.bucketName='cloudbridge-sync-bucket'
AND eventTime >= from_iso8601_timestamp('2024-11-01T00:00:00Z')
AND eventName IN ('GetObject','HeadObject','ListObjectsV2')
```
VendorOpsBot: CloudBridge responded that they rotated the exposed token at 2024-11-02T03:12:00Z and scrubbed debug files; they shared redacted access excerpts and SHA256s of removed artifacts.
Maya R.: ask them for raw access logs (CloudTrail-style) showing principal ARNs and source IPs for any accesses with that token. we need proof no reads of our buckets. also request their bucket policy history and S3 ACL change timeline.
Sam K.: flagged: also confirm whether their token had any IAM/KMS cross-account capability. if their principal was granted ability to call aws:kms:Decrypt on any CMK, that's escalation.
VendorOpsBot: vendor says token scoped to their bucket only. policy snippet attached: 
```
{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::cloudbridge-sync-bucket/*"}
```
Maya R.: that helps but we want a signed attestation and the full policy history. meanwhile rotate our secret and any IAM creds that were explicitly trusting them. do it now.
Sam K.: rotating Vault secret: `vault kv put secret/integrations/cloudbridge sync_token="REDACTED_new_$(date +%s)"` — done. updating INC-20241102-CB ticket.
Security Oncall: kicked off KMS grant audit across accounts. initial check: no CMK grants to a CloudBridge principal in our account. still rotating role keys that were used by integration.
Lee T.: vendor posted root cause: deploy automation applied public-read ACL for ~12 minutes (2024-11-02T02:58:00Z to 2024-11-02T03:10:00Z). they included object hashes present in that window and a scrub log.
Maya R.: containment looks OK. next: confirm vendor timeline, mitigation steps, and independent verification. require proof that their scrub removed all debug artifacts.
eng-infra: action item to add an ACL preflight check to our deploy pipeline and an alert for sudden object-list spikes. filing ENGINFRA-231 for tracking.
Lee T.: security to run GuardDuty/CloudTrail analytic query for anomalous GetObject volume and cross-account reads in last 7 days and during the window.
Security Oncall: running queries and will attach results to INC-20241102-CB. initial scan found no reads from our IP blocks during the window. continuing deeper analysis.
Priya L. (Legal): quick note — we'll need to determine notification obligations. Maya, can you draft an internal notification summary and a short customer line in case Legal elevates?
Maya R.: drafting customer note: "We were notified by CloudBridge of a limited exposure due to their misconfiguration. We have no evidence customer data was accessed. We rotated integration credentials and are conducting a joint investigation with CloudBridge." keeping it concise.
VendorOpsBot: CloudBridge requests confirmation their rotation is accepted and proposes a technical call tomorrow 16:00 UTC for joint validation.
Maya R.: schedule the call, include eng leads, security oncall, Legal, and vendor relations. @VendorOpsBot please send invite and include vendor post-incident attestation PDF.
Lee T.: post-incident owner list: eng-infra (pipeline & alerts), security (audit trail + Forensics), service teams (RBAC review & least-privilege enforcement), Vendor Relations (attestation collection), Legal (customer notification decision).
Sam K.: incident ticket INC-20241102-CB created and I added vendor artifacts + remediation checklist and ETA items. tagging follow-ups with owners. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident INC-20241102-CB status updated: contained -> investigating. next update scheduled in 3h.
Maya R.: closing Slack thread for now. will post a postmortem draft after the joint call and evidence review. thanks all for the quick response.
